entities.name: Rem Karolus
entities.description: The most feared and revered of the Thraben inquisitors on Innistrad.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: Church whose inquisitors can be hired.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel whose spear Karolus brought to Thalia.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Massive floating Eldrazi Karolus could not reach.

entities.name: Vadrik
entities.description: Astronomer who hunted Old Stickfingers with Karolus.

entities.name: Arinos
entities.description: Farmer who summoned Old Stickfingers to kill Salvasi.

entities.name: Lambholt
entities.description: Village where the hunt took place.

entities.name: Saint Traft
entities.description: Ally of Rem during the Invasion.

events.summary: After Avacyn's death Karolus brings her spear to Thalia and the Order of Saint Traft.
events.quote: After Avacyn 's death, he brought her spear to Thalia and the Order of Saint Traft .

events.summary: Unable to reach Emrakul, Karolus tames the largest wild gryff he can find.
events.quote: Karolus tamed the largest wild gryff he could find

events.summary: Karolus and Vadrik are hired to find the vanished farmer Arinos.
events.quote: Karolus and the astronomer Vadrik were employed to find a farmer named Arinos

events.summary: They wound Old Stickfingers, learn Arinos summoned it to kill Salvasi, and banish it.
events.quote: After employing a ritual to banish Old Stickfingers, Vadrik and Rem parted on good terms.

events.summary: During the Invasion Rem teams up with Saint Traft to protect the plane.
events.quote: Rem teamed up with Saint Traft to protect the plane

relations.quote: Like all inquisitors from the Church of Avacyn
Vadrik and Rem parted on good terms

relations.note: Summoned the creature to kill him.
relations.quote: it was Arinos who had summoned Old Stickfingers to kill Salvasi
